verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Infrastructure Manager supports declarative Terraform definitions and preview deployments. Nothing documents importing existing resources into IaC or detecting drift. Preview of planned changes is a different capability from import or drift workflows. The API hub metadata sync reconciles API catalogs, not infrastructure state, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, existing resources can come under IaC — documented import/drift workflows instead of a greenfield-only story
